baseline_models.focus_anchor: الذين يدعون / يبتغون إلى ربهم الوسيلة / أيهم أقرب
baseline_models.mechanism: The beings marked by human-directed calling are immediately recast as active seekers toward their own Lord. The comparative of nearness orders access without making any member of the group an independent endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Directed calling identifies the group as objects of appeal, whose direction of dependence the next verb reverses.
Active pursuit makes the called beings need-seekers rather than settled possessors of access.
Lordship and ownership supply the common terminus above both callers and called.
Nearness supplies a comparative gradient of approach, not autonomous control.

changed_reading.before: People call exalted intermediaries because those figures are already endpoints of access.
changed_reading.after: The called figures are themselves moving on the same dependency axis toward their Lord; relative nearness does not terminate dependence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يرجون رحمته ويخافون عذابه / إن عذاب ربك كان محذورا
baseline_models.mechanism: Hope pulls the seekers toward mercy while fear and the final warning constrain that movement. Repetition of punishment turns the pair from decorative emotions into a regulatory approach system.

activation_trace.role: Heartward expectation supplies the attractive forward pull.
Tender mercy supplies the sought positive field.
Expectation of harm supplies an opposing brake rather than simple despair.
Painful penalty gives the feared pole objective content and is repeated for emphasis.
Wakeful precaution converts fear into guarded conduct.

changed_reading.before: Hope and fear merely describe the inner piety of the invoked figures.
changed_reading.after: Their approach is dynamically governed by attraction to mercy and vigilant avoidance of a real penalty, displaying dependence in action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claims of selected divine offspring and angelic status are first exposed as speech, then even hypothetical gods are made to seek a traversable path to the possessor of the throne. The near-identical seeking construction activates 17:57 as the explanatory return: claimed rank never removes path-dependence.

activation_trace.role: Selection supplies the claimed privilege whose theological force is being challenged.
Filial attribution turns privilege into a claimed relation of divine descent.
The angel branch identifies the beings placed inside the false kinship claim.
Saying or attributing what is not so marks that exalted genealogy as a speech-made status.
Worshipped beings provide the hypothetical maximum case of an alleged independent divine rank.
Even that maximum case is assigned active seeking, matching the focus mechanism.
The elevated royal seat marks a holder above the hypothetical seekers and fixes their direction.
A path that must be traversed anticipates the focus ayah's means of approach.

structural_cues: 17:40 frames angelic filiation as an enormous saying; 17:42 repeats ابتغى + إلى + a route noun before 17:57 repeats ابتغى + إلى + الوسيلة; 17:43 then places God above what is said.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a false rank claim and a hypothetical path-seeking construction; I infer that the repeated syntax is a functional bridge to the called seekers in 17:57. A live alternative is that 17:42 tests generic rival gods while 17:57 has a narrower referent set.

changed_reading.before: أيهم أقرب may rank semi-independent intermediaries by inherent sacred status.
changed_reading.after: The ranking occurs inside a shared need to find a route to the sole Lord; even the highest claimed status remains derivative and seeking.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal glorification places every creature in a Godward act, while failure to understand that glorification explains how worshippers can mistake fellow worshippers for destinations. The focus seekers become audible members of a larger orientation rather than isolated intermediaries.

activation_trace.role: Worship through glorification gives all creation a shared direction toward God.
Praise supplies the content of that common Godward response.
Failure of understanding explains the hearer's misreading of creaturely orientation.

structural_cues: The universal subjects of 17:44 include heavens, earth, and every thing, followed by the direct concession that the audience does not understand their glorification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal praise and human noncomprehension; I place the beings called in 17:57 inside that universal class. The alternative is that 17:44 remains cosmological background without specifying the focus referents.

changed_reading.before: The invoked beings occupy a special devotional channel facing the human caller.
changed_reading.after: They are fellow participants in creation's Godward praise, and their own seeking is what an uncomprehending caller has failed to hear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Veiling, auditory weight, turning away, and inability to find a path form an access-failure sequence. Against it, seeking the means and being nearer in 17:57 can be read as degrees of receptive access and right orientation, not merely spatial rank.

activation_trace.role: Prevention of access supplies the first obstruction on the approach axis.
Heaviness in the ear makes failed access perceptual and responsive, not geographical.
Turning away supplies the agentive reversal from approach to withdrawal.
Loss of intended direction explains why the obstructed audience cannot approach.
The unavailable traversable path is the negative image against which الوسيلة becomes functional.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from a hidden barrier in 17:45, through covered hearts and weighted ears in 17:46, to turning backs and finally inability to find a path in 17:48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barriers, withdrawal, and path failure; I map their inverse onto the focus construction of means and nearness. A live alternative is that this is a moral-cognitive condition around revelation rather than part of the semantic content of الوسيلة itself.

changed_reading.before: Nearness is a fixed vertical location possessed by selected beings.
changed_reading.after: Nearness also names successful access and orientation: the called seekers remain open and moving where the resistant hearers are blocked and turn away.

context_deltas.mechanism: A temporally near event culminates in God calling and the whole audience answering with praise. This reverses the apparent direction of 17:57: entities called by humans remain, at the decisive horizon, respondents downstream of the divine call.

activation_trace.role: Temporal nearness moves the focus's proximity axis toward the approaching summons.
God's directed call establishes the ultimate caller in the sequence.
Answering speech places creatures, including exalted ones, on the respondent side.
Praise makes the response explicitly Godward rather than self-terminating.

structural_cues: The tight sequence قريبًا / يوم يدعوكم / فتستجيبون gives nearness, call, and response an explicit temporal-causal order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the near divine summons and universal response; I use it to invert the human call relation in 17:57. The alternative is that قريبًا in 17:51 is only temporal and should not color the comparative قرب of the focus ayah.

changed_reading.before: Human invocation places the called being in the role of final answerer.
changed_reading.after: The called being is itself a future respondent to the Lord's call; human invocation cannot reverse the ultimate caller-response hierarchy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy and punishment are symmetrically assigned to the Lord's will, custodial control is denied even to the messenger, and real differences of prophetic rank and scripture are presented as bestowed. Thus comparative nearness may be real while remaining entirely distinct from control of outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Lordship identifies the agent above both alternatives of treatment.
The repeated willing construction assigns both mercy and punishment to one volitional source.
Merciful tenderness is explicitly an act of that source rather than a resource held by an intermediary.
Painful penalty is the symmetrical alternative under the same agency.
The negated sufficient custodian constrains any transfer of comprehensive control to the messenger.
Degree and excellence allow a real hierarchy among prophets without making it self-originating.
Bestowal marks the distinguished gift as received, preserving dependence within rank.

structural_cues: 17:54 balances إن يشأ يرحمكم with إن يشأ يعذبكم and then denies comprehensive trusteeship; 17:55 immediately affirms differentiated favor and a bestowed book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unified agency, denied custodianship, and bestowed rank; I infer that 17:57's comparative nearness measures dependent favor rather than outcome-control. The live alternative is that the trusteeship denial is specific to the messenger's responsibility for this audience and does not exhaust all secondary agency.

changed_reading.before: The nearest figure may independently deliver mercy or shield from punishment.
changed_reading.after: Nearness and favor can differ among servants, but mercy, punishment, and comprehensive custody remain the Lord's; rank is received rather than sovereign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to call the claimed beings is followed by a double inability: they do not possess removal of harm or its transfer. The focus ayah then supplies the causal explanation for that incapacity: those called are themselves seeking access to their Lord.

activation_trace.role: Directed invocation repeats the focus relation and isolates the tested objects of appeal.
An assertion without certainty marks their alleged status as a claim under test.
Possession and disposal name precisely the capacity negated of the invoked beings.
Lifting a covering supplies the concrete model of removing affliction that they cannot perform.
Harm and deficit specify the outcome outside their possession.
Transfer from one state to another supplies the second denied form of control.

structural_cues: 17:56's فلا يملكون governs both كشف الضر and تحويلا; 17:57 begins with the same called-beings construction and immediately predicates seeking of them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent invocation, double incapacity, and the focus's seeking predicate; I infer that dependence explains incapacity. A live alternative is that 17:56's claimed beings are only a subset of the broader grammatical possibilities in 17:57.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely praises the devotion of otherwise effective intermediaries.
changed_reading.after: Their own seeking explains why invocation cannot make them controllers of harm: the supposed providers are fellow dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayat materializes punishment as destruction or severe pain already inscribed, then states that signs are sent to induce fear. The focus's محذورا therefore exceeds subjective dread: it calls for prepared vigilance before an objective, declared possibility.

activation_trace.role: Falling into destruction supplies one concrete realization of the warned outcome.
Painful penalty repeats and intensifies the focus's feared object.
Force and hardness increase the objective weight of the penalty.
Inscription as an obligating determination makes the threat more than an imagined feeling.
The written line gives that determination an explicit fixed record.
Inducing fear defines revelation's warning function as moving hearers into precaution.

structural_cues: 17:58 coordinates destruction and severe punishment before saying it is written; 17:59 closes by restricting the sending of signs to a warning function.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concrete punishment, inscription, and fear-induction; I infer that focus fear should issue in preparedness. The alternative is that written status emphasizes certainty of decree without specifying how each seeker acts.

changed_reading.before: محذورا only reports that punishment happens to be feared by the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: Punishment is a declared and objective constraint, and proper fear is the alert preparation that revelation is designed to produce.

context_deltas.mechanism: Encompassing knowledge, trial, warning, and increased transgression show that warning does not mechanically improve every hearer. The focus figures' coordinated hope and fear now mark a receptive response profile, contrasted with an audience in whom warning amplifies boundary-crossing.

activation_trace.role: Complete encompassing knowledge fixes the warning inside divine awareness rather than informational uncertainty.
Testing supplies a setting in which the same sign can disclose different responses.
Induced fear repeats the intended caution-producing function of warning.
Increase supplies the counterintuitive amplification produced in resistant hearers.
Crossing the limit names the first mapped image of the response opposed to vigilant fear.
The split mapped root independently preserves the same limit-crossing image as the outcome of resisted warning.

structural_cues: The explicit sequence ونخوفهم فما يزيدهم إلا طغيانا makes warning precede, yet fail to determine, the audience's response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning followed by increased transgression; I infer that the balanced hope and fear in 17:57 characterize receptivity rather than automatic stimulus. A live alternative is that the focus seekers and the warned human audience are too distinct for direct contrast.

changed_reading.before: Fear is a uniform reaction automatically caused by exposure to threat.
changed_reading.after: Fear joined to hope is a responsive discipline; warning can instead harden resistance, so the seekers' posture itself distinguishes their relation to the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates bodily and nurturing branches rather than the ordinary abstract senses. It remains anchored in the focus's رب, رحمة, عذاب, and حذر sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of dependence, not as a lexical replacement for mercy or punishment.

activation_trace.role: Gradual nurture and completion cast lordship as maintenance of dependent life.
The womb as a generative enclosure gives mercy a material image of protected formation.
Withholding and weaning supply punishment's opposite image as severance from sustaining access.
Prepared vigilance becomes the dependent being's posture at the boundary between nurture and cutoff.

changed_reading.before: Mercy and punishment are unrelated rewards placed after the search for a means.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the search is for sustained dependent relation: mercy encloses and forms, while punishment threatens withholding or severance from that nurture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the milk-residue image inside دعو. It remains validly anchored to the exact called-seeker transition and to قرب as a means of approach, but downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for redirected attention, never as the asserted etymology of invocation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الذين يدعون يبتغون إلى ربهم الوسيلة أيهم أقرب

activation_trace.role: A retained trace that draws what follows models the invoked figure as a pointer eliciting onward movement rather than dispensing the result.
Active seeking supplies the onward movement elicited by that pointer.
A means or offering used to seek nearness directs the movement beyond the sign toward God.

changed_reading.before: The invoked figure is a reservoir from which access is dispensed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the figure is only a retained sign that draws the seeker onward; its proper function is to redirect invocation toward the Lord it also seeks.

strongest_changes: The 17:42 path-seeking construction makes 17:57 a return that places even maximally exalted claimants inside dependence.
The call-response sequence in 17:52 reverses human invocation: all creatures remain respondents to the Lord's call.
17:54-56 separate real rank from control, assigning mercy and punishment to divine will and denying the invoked beings possession of harm-removal or transfer.
17:58-60 turn fear into objective preparedness while showing that warning can disclose opposite response profiles.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses a reversal of agency: those treated as destinations are seekers, those expected to answer are respondents, and those imagined to control outcomes are governed by hope and fear. The context repeatedly activates this reversal through route, access, call, custody, and warning mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the full referential scope of الذين يدعون, so models preserve a class-level reading rather than naming a single group.
The focus noun الوسيلة has no branch inventory in the packet; its role is anchored structurally and through neighboring route language, not by an invented branch citation.
أيهم أقرب may encode a ranking among the seekers or a more complex selection relation; the retained models do not force a final parse.
The womb, weaning, and residual-draw readings are deliberately contained branch analogies and should not be promoted to ordinary lexical senses.
